profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at CGI
profile.summary: Software Developer with an expertise in distributed and client server system applications, database, system utilities, reporting applications and image processing.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Review requirements specified by the Business System consultant specific for Forms
in Property IT for Progressive Insurance.
• Apply code changes meeting the requirements.
• Thorough development testing of the code changes in Crystal Reports 2020.
• Document and update Development Test plans.
• Write Unit testing (Mocked up test scripts) in code base.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented Azure Virtual Machines, Azure Storage, and Azure Active Directory to enhance security and accessibility.
•	Configured Azure Monitor and Security Center to ensure system reliability and compliance.
•	Planned and coordinated data migrations between OnBase and in-house (IAConnect) designed SQL 2008 DataBase systems.
•	Designed, installed, monitored, maintained, and tuned production databases while ensuring high levels of data availability.
•	Worked closely with designated clients to analyze, define, develop, test, deploy, and maintain SQL DataBases.
•	Planned and coordinated data migrations between OnBase, CostPoint and CRMS systems.
•	Monitored database system details for Clients, including stored procedures and query execution time, worked with vendor (Hyland) to implement index tuning and efficiency improvements.
•	Developed a Plug-In for Microsoft Outlook for NASA. Plug-In reads all emails in multiple Inboxes, moves any attachments to a folder together with the body of an email message. An XML file is created with a listing of all attachments and moved to a directory where Kofax XML Import Connector polls for xml files.
•	Designed web applications using Custom Style-Sheets, JavaScript and HTML. Web form added users selected from a drop-down menu list into an object table. Used Document Object Model (DOM) to iterate through the table and perform checks. 
•	Designed a Plug-In for Microsoft Outlook which kept track of employees or users availability and also created methods to be called from a WebService Application using VB 2008.
•	Support and troubleshoot OnBase 12.0 and earlier environments.
•	Support and troubleshoot Kofax Capture 10 Client Server environments and earlier systems.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · SQL · OnBase · Kofax Capture

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed a Food Database Management System for USDA employees to serve as a user interface for a backend database system. Application was developed in VB 2005 and ADO.NET 2.0 to communicate with client database housed on a backend server. Incorporated Crystal Reports with the application for creating and producing customized reports. Requirement included software architecture, design, coding, derived conversion methods for existing code and components and developed an automated comparison utility for table column comparisons.
•	Hands on development of all parts of the application. GUI design, business object layer, database. Utilized VB.NET, ADO.Net, SQL and Crystal Reports.
•	Redesigned and converted database designed in Paradox into Access 2003.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed a user interface to replace a Document Scanning Application with Visual Basic.Net 2003. 
•	Assisted with the upgrade of current in-house applications designed with Visual Basic 6.0 to Visual Basic.Net 2003.
•	Served as work order manager to about 8 employees on the FECS DMA project that troubleshoots software application built to handle Scanned Disability Claims into a Websphere Application Server and a Windows 2000 Server Front End Server.
•	Re-Designed an Active X Control that adds a Print Document Menu to the Document Validation Application designed by Kofax Ascent Capture version 5.51 with Visual Basic 6.0. Designed code to Merge Single Tiff Images together to form a document and transmit document to the print queue.
•	Assisted with the development, design and maintenance of a Database Poller Application to interface with IBM DB2.
•	Troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis on issues dependent on IBM Content Manager and IBM eClient application.
•	Developed a Service using Visual Basic .NET 2003 which will delete files older than a set number of days on a Windows 2000/2003 server.
•	Redesigned and upgraded a Windows Service from Visual Basic 6.0 to Visual Studio .Net 2003 and implemented multithreading in the application.
•	Customized a Validation Module designed by Ascent Capture to index documents prior to the documents transfer into the repository server, IBM Content Manager Tier 3.
•	Assisted in the Development of a Web Based Document Management System. This has a very complex Database Schema, and Developed in ASP.NET
•	Performed regression tests on all applications developed in-house.
•	Create, edit and debug XML-related files with Altova XMLSpy.
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Microsoft SQL Server · Kofax Capture · XML Spy
